name: Bits Incremental!
desc:
Welcome to Bits Incremental! [V2.1.0]

This game is basically an incremental where you click to spawn various "bits"!
With these bits you can purchase upgrades and discover new currencies!
You can also compete for leaderboards!
However, you'll need some luck to advance in game!

Join the group to start with extra bits!

To play in CO-OP multiplayer, you will need to use the new multiplayer menu in the main menu. Please note the 200p servers do not save data, as they are intended as one giant coop session.

Local splitscreen requires the use of controllers. Some devices may not support 8 players.

The game DOES save your data!
Note that there may be some bugs, please tell me if so!

Inspired by "Clicker Incremental" by @DaMouseDev

Made by @TheAntOfTheWorld for Ant Nest Studio
Helped by scripter @louisd5
